newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.523 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.523 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.523 percent at its auction of 91-day Treasury bills for 150 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on August 28 for 100 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.538 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.540/500 percent against 6.545/520 a week ago, Bank Negara said.
